title: First ultrasound.
note: We went to the first ultrasound and got to see the first heartbeat, confirming a viable pregnancy. Your little heart was beating at around 115 BPM. You measured about 7mm.

title: Conception.
note: Mum stopped birth control and within a week we had successfully conceived. We didn't realise it would be so instantaneous.

title: We didn't know that we were pregnant yet.
note: We were still trying without realising we had already succeeded.

title: We did a few pregnancy tests but they came back negative.
note: Mum bought a single test after contemplating a three pack. She ended up buying the three pack later.

title: I think on the 11th of March we did a test and it immediately turned positive!
The wait feels like it will take forever
note: But i'm sure this next 7ish months will be very quick

title: Blood test results
note: We got the blood test results back. No signs of anything concerning. Confirmation of a healthy baby. We're looking forward to the ultrasound in a couple of days.

title: Subchorionic hematoma
note: We had a big scare in the early hours of the morning. Mum woke up with significant bleeding. Dad fainted... Straight to hospital, not for dad. Midwives at the hospital couldn't do anything. Had to wait till nearly 1pm the next day to talk to an OBGYN who was not concerned about it whatsoever.
